facts.fact: Angola Cables launched GO4AI on 12 June 2026 at ANGOTIC 2026 in Luanda, a self-service marketplace offering on-demand GPUs (NVIDIA L40S, A100, B200) and NPUs for AI training and inference, billed in local currency, per Forbes Africa Lusofona.
